dedupe_keys.name: communaute de communes des liseres de l oise cycling and walking datasets

description: Communauté de communes des Lisères de l'Oise: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de communes des Lisères de l'Oise. Coverage: Communauté de communes des Lisères de l'Oise. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Aménagement cyclable sur la Communauté de Communes des Lisières de l'O; Itinéraire cyclable sur la Communauté de Communes des Lisières de l'Oi; Equipement cyclable sur la Communauté de Communes des Lisières de l'Oi; Repère cyclable sur la Communauté de Communes des Lisières de l'Oise. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
